As a Project Manager at Reecomps Teleservices, responsible for the end-to-end management of telecom projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget control, and high-quality implementation of network solutions. Acts as the primary point of contact between clients, vendors, and internal teams to deliver telecom infrastructure projects aligned with business goals.

Plan, execute, and manage telecom projects from initiation to closure, ensuring adherence to timelines, scope, and budget.• Manage project lifecycle including requirement gathering, planning, resource allocation, execution, monitoring, and final delivery.
Coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams (Network Engineers, Field Engineers, Operations) to ensure seamlessproject execution.
Define project scope, goals, deliverables, and resource requirements.
Monitor and track project progress using project management tools and KPIs.
Manage risks, identify potential bottlenecks, and implement mitigation strategies.
Ensure projects comply with telecom industry standards, safety regulations, and internal policies.
Facilitate regular project status meetings and communicate project progress to stakeholders.
Prepare and maintain detailed project documentation, including project plans, schedules, budgets, and reports.
Oversee installation, commissioning, and testing of network equipment (routers, switches, fiber installations).
Handle vendor management, procurement of materials, and budget tracking.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery without compromising quality.
Ensure customer satisfaction by addressing queries, resolving issues, and providing regular updates.
